crawl.label: Foundational visibility
crawl.description: Centralize the first set of high-value logs and confirm searchable visibility.
crawl.internalMeaning: Prioritize core telemetry onboarding, validation searches, and first dashboards.
crawl.customerFacingText: Start by centralizing the highest-value data sources and validating that teams can search and investigate from one place.

crawl.label: Initial security visibility
crawl.description: Establish baseline security logging from identity, endpoint, and perimeter sources.
crawl.internalMeaning: Onboard AD, firewall, and endpoint telemetry with first security dashboards.
crawl.customerFacingText: Begin with identity, endpoint, and network perimeter logs to establish a security baseline.

crawl.label: Linux server monitoring
crawl.description: Bring Linux system and application logs into Splunk for operations and security.
crawl.internalMeaning: Prioritize syslog, auditd, and key application logs from Linux estates.
crawl.customerFacingText: Centralize Linux server and application logs for search and basic monitoring.

crawl.label: Identity and authentication baseline
crawl.description: Capture sign-in and authentication events from core identity systems.
crawl.internalMeaning: Onboard AD/Azure AD/Okta sign-in logs with first identity dashboards.
crawl.customerFacingText: Establish visibility into sign-ins and authentication activity from core identity platforms.

crawl.label: Network perimeter baseline
crawl.description: Collect firewall and perimeter device logs for traffic and threat visibility.
crawl.internalMeaning: Onboard perimeter firewalls with traffic and threat prevention logging.
crawl.customerFacingText: Start with perimeter firewall logs to understand traffic and blocked activity.

crawl.label: Cloud audit baseline
crawl.description: Enable cloud platform audit and control-plane logging.
crawl.internalMeaning: Onboard AWS CloudTrail, Azure Activity, or GCP audit logs.
crawl.customerFacingText: Turn on cloud audit logging so platform changes and API activity are searchable.

crawl.label: DNS visibility
crawl.description: Capture DNS query and resolution logs for security and operations.
crawl.internalMeaning: Onboard DNS server or resolver logs for investigation context.
crawl.customerFacingText: Add DNS logging to support threat hunting and operational troubleshooting.

crawl.label: Application log visibility
crawl.description: Centralize logs from priority business applications.
crawl.internalMeaning: Onboard top-tier application logs with parsing validation.
crawl.customerFacingText: Bring critical application logs into Splunk for search and triage.

crawl.label: Basic dashboarding
crawl.description: Create first operational and security dashboards for stakeholders.
crawl.internalMeaning: Build starter dashboards tied to onboarded sources and use cases.
crawl.customerFacingText: Deliver initial dashboards so teams can monitor key metrics without ad-hoc searches.

crawl.label: Ingest validation
crawl.description: Validate parsing, timestamps, and field extraction on onboarded sources.
crawl.internalMeaning: Run field discovery and ingest QA on each new source.
crawl.customerFacingText: Confirm data arrives correctly with expected fields and timestamps before expanding scope.

crawl.label: Source owner alignment
crawl.description: Identify owners and logging scope for each onboarded source.
crawl.internalMeaning: Document source owners, retention, and logging policies.
crawl.customerFacingText: Align with source owners on what is logged, who owns it, and how it will be used.

crawl.label: First searches and investigations
crawl.description: Enable analysts to run saved searches and basic investigations.
crawl.internalMeaning: Publish starter searches and investigation playbooks.
crawl.customerFacingText: Equip the team with starter searches and a simple investigation workflow.

crawl.label: First security use cases
crawl.description: Implement a small set of high-value security detections or use cases.
crawl.internalMeaning: Deploy 3–5 starter detections aligned to onboarded telemetry.
crawl.customerFacingText: Start with a focused set of security use cases that match available data.

crawl.label: Operational visibility
crawl.description: Establish IT operations monitoring for infrastructure health.
crawl.internalMeaning: Onboard infra metrics and service logs for ops dashboards.
crawl.customerFacingText: Give IT operations baseline visibility into infrastructure and service health.

crawl.label: Compliance evidence start
crawl.description: Begin collecting audit evidence from systems in scope for compliance.
crawl.internalMeaning: Onboard audit logs required for initial compliance controls.
crawl.customerFacingText: Start collecting audit evidence needed for compliance programs in scope.

crawl.label: Windows endpoint baseline
crawl.description: Collect Windows security and system events from endpoints.
crawl.internalMeaning: Onboard Windows Event Log and Defender telemetry.
crawl.customerFacingText: Centralize Windows endpoint events for security and operations.

crawl.label: Email and collaboration baseline
crawl.description: Bring email and M365/O365 audit activity into Splunk.
crawl.internalMeaning: Onboard Exchange or M365 unified audit logs.
crawl.customerFacingText: Add email and collaboration audit logs for identity and threat investigations.

crawl.label: VPN and remote access
crawl.description: Capture VPN and remote access authentication and session logs.
crawl.internalMeaning: Onboard VPN concentrator and remote access logs.
crawl.customerFacingText: Monitor VPN and remote access activity for security and capacity planning.

crawl.label: Web proxy baseline
crawl.description: Collect web proxy logs for URL and threat visibility.
crawl.internalMeaning: Onboard proxy logs with URL categorization where available.
crawl.customerFacingText: Add web proxy logs to understand user browsing and blocked requests.

crawl.label: Database audit start
crawl.description: Enable database audit and access logging for critical databases.
crawl.internalMeaning: Onboard DB audit logs for tier-1 databases.
crawl.customerFacingText: Start database audit logging for sensitive data stores.

crawl.label: Container / Kubernetes pilot
crawl.description: Pilot container and Kubernetes log collection.
crawl.internalMeaning: Onboard a pilot cluster with container stdout and audit logs.
crawl.customerFacingText: Run a pilot to bring Kubernetes and container logs into Splunk.

crawl.label: SIEM console replacement
crawl.description: Replace console-hopping with a single search and dashboard experience.
crawl.internalMeaning: Consolidate daily checks into Splunk dashboards and saved searches.
crawl.customerFacingText: Replace daily multi-console checks with unified Splunk visibility.

crawl.label: Threat intelligence feeds
crawl.description: Integrate baseline threat intelligence feeds for enrichment.
crawl.internalMeaning: Add open or licensed TI feeds for IP and domain enrichment.
crawl.customerFacingText: Enrich events with threat intelligence to speed investigations.

crawl.label: Asset inventory start
crawl.description: Establish an asset and inventory baseline from available sources.
crawl.internalMeaning: Onboard CMDB or discovery data for asset context.
crawl.customerFacingText: Build an initial asset inventory view from CMDB and discovery sources.

crawl.label: Log retention alignment
crawl.description: Align retention and indexing tiers with stakeholder requirements.
crawl.internalMeaning: Document retention per source and index strategy.
crawl.customerFacingText: Align log retention and indexing with legal, security, and cost requirements.

crawl.label: Parsing and field standardization
crawl.description: Standardize sourcetypes, fields, and CIM alignment on onboarded data.
crawl.internalMeaning: Apply props, aliases, and CIM tags on priority sources.
crawl.customerFacingText: Standardize parsing and fields so searches work consistently across sources.

crawl.label: Stakeholder demonstration
crawl.description: Prepare a stakeholder demo of initial Splunk value.
crawl.internalMeaning: Build demo dashboards and sample investigations for leadership.
crawl.customerFacingText: Demonstrate initial Splunk value to stakeholders with real customer data.

crawl.label: Help desk integration
crawl.description: Connect Splunk views to help desk or ticketing workflows.
crawl.internalMeaning: Link notable events or dashboards to ticket creation.
crawl.customerFacingText: Integrate Splunk visibility with help desk workflows for faster response.

crawl.label: Backup and recovery logs
crawl.description: Collect backup job and recovery logs for operational assurance.
crawl.internalMeaning: Onboard backup software logs for job success monitoring.
crawl.customerFacingText: Monitor backup and recovery job status from centralized logs.

crawl.label: Foundational training
crawl.description: Train the team on Splunk search, dashboards, and intake workflows.
crawl.internalMeaning: Deliver Splunk fundamentals training for analysts and admins.
crawl.customerFacingText: Train the team on core Splunk skills for search, dashboards, and daily use.

walk.label: Expand correlation
walk.description: Add enrichment and cross-source correlation beyond day-one sources.
walk.internalMeaning: Onboard enrichment sources and multi-source correlation searches.
walk.customerFacingText: Expand beyond initial sources with enrichment and cross-domain correlation.

walk.label: Add enrichment sources
walk.description: Bring in CMDB, asset, vulnerability, and identity context.
walk.internalMeaning: Onboard CMDB, vulnerability scanners, and identity governance feeds.
walk.customerFacingText: Add enrichment data so investigations have asset and risk context.

walk.label: Improve detection coverage
walk.description: Expand detection content across MITRE tactics and priority use cases.
walk.internalMeaning: Deploy additional correlation searches and notable event workflows.
walk.customerFacingText: Broaden detection coverage across priority security use cases.

walk.label: Identity-endpoint-network correlation
walk.description: Correlate identity, endpoint, and network events in investigations.
walk.internalMeaning: Build cross-domain searches linking user, device, and traffic.
walk.customerFacingText: Connect identity, endpoint, and network telemetry in unified investigations.

walk.label: Add vulnerability context
walk.description: Integrate vulnerability scan and risk data for prioritization.
walk.internalMeaning: Onboard Qualys, Tenable, or Rapid7 with asset mapping.
walk.customerFacingText: Add vulnerability context to prioritize remediation and detections.

walk.label: Add asset context
walk.description: Enrich events with authoritative asset and ownership data.
walk.internalMeaning: Onboard CMDB or ServiceNow asset data with lookups.
walk.customerFacingText: Enrich events with asset ownership and classification data.

walk.label: Cloud and SaaS expansion
walk.description: Expand cloud control plane and SaaS application coverage.
walk.internalMeaning: Add additional cloud regions, SaaS apps, and CASB logs.
walk.customerFacingText: Expand cloud and SaaS logging as workloads grow.

walk.label: Service health views
walk.description: Build service-level dashboards and SLO-oriented views.
walk.internalMeaning: Create service maps and health dashboards per critical service.
walk.customerFacingText: Deliver service health views aligned to business services.

walk.label: Dashboard refinement
walk.description: Refine dashboards based on analyst and stakeholder feedback.
walk.internalMeaning: Iterate dashboards with user feedback and KPI alignment.
walk.customerFacingText: Refine dashboards based on how analysts and leaders actually use them.

walk.label: Alert tuning
walk.description: Tune alert volume, thresholds, and suppression rules.
walk.internalMeaning: Review notable volume and tune correlation searches.
walk.customerFacingText: Tune alerts to reduce noise while maintaining detection efficacy.

walk.label: CIM data model validation
walk.description: Validate CIM compliance and acceleration for key data models.
walk.internalMeaning: Run CIM validation and accelerate priority data models.
walk.customerFacingText: Validate CIM alignment and accelerate models for performance.

walk.label: Investigation workflows
walk.description: Formalize investigation playbooks and case workflows.
walk.internalMeaning: Document and automate top investigation scenarios.
walk.customerFacingText: Establish repeatable investigation workflows for common scenarios.

walk.label: Multi-source correlation
walk.description: Build correlation across three or more telemetry domains.
walk.internalMeaning: Deploy searches joining identity, network, endpoint, and cloud.
walk.customerFacingText: Correlate across multiple telemetry domains for richer context.

walk.label: Expand to non-production
walk.description: Extend logging to dev/test for parity and pre-prod validation.
walk.internalMeaning: Onboard non-prod environments with reduced retention.
walk.customerFacingText: Extend visibility to non-production for testing and parity.

walk.label: Operational reporting
walk.description: Deliver recurring operational reports for IT and security leaders.
walk.internalMeaning: Schedule reports for uptime, incidents, and security KPIs.
walk.customerFacingText: Provide recurring operational reports for leadership review.

walk.label: SOAR integration pilot
walk.description: Pilot SOAR playbooks for top alert types.
walk.internalMeaning: Connect notable events to SOAR with 2–3 starter playbooks.
walk.customerFacingText: Pilot automation playbooks for the highest-volume alert types.

walk.label: UEBA exploration
walk.description: Evaluate user and entity behavior analytics on identity data.
walk.internalMeaning: Pilot UEBA on identity and access telemetry.
walk.customerFacingText: Explore behavioral analytics to detect anomalous user activity.

walk.label: Threat hunting program
walk.description: Establish a lightweight threat hunting cadence.
walk.internalMeaning: Schedule monthly hunts on priority hypotheses.
walk.customerFacingText: Start a regular threat hunting program with documented hypotheses.

walk.label: Executive KPI dashboards
walk.description: Build executive dashboards for security and operations KPIs.
walk.internalMeaning: Create leadership views for risk, incidents, and compliance posture.
walk.customerFacingText: Give executives clear KPI dashboards without search complexity.

walk.label: Data model acceleration
walk.description: Accelerate tstats-friendly data models for performance.
walk.internalMeaning: Enable acceleration on Network Traffic, Authentication, and Endpoint models.
walk.customerFacingText: Accelerate data models to improve search performance at scale.

walk.label: Ingest capacity planning
walk.description: Plan ingest growth and license alignment for expansion.
walk.internalMeaning: Model ingest growth and license needs for walk-phase sources.
walk.customerFacingText: Plan ingest capacity as new sources and retention requirements grow.

walk.label: Partner team enablement
walk.description: Enable adjacent teams (NetOps, AppOps) on Splunk workflows.
walk.internalMeaning: Train partner teams on dashboards and self-service searches.
walk.customerFacingText: Enable partner teams to use Splunk for their operational needs.

walk.label: Compliance reporting
walk.description: Automate compliance reports for in-scope frameworks.
walk.internalMeaning: Build scheduled compliance reports with evidence links.
walk.customerFacingText: Automate compliance reporting for frameworks in scope.

walk.label: OT/IT convergence planning
walk.description: Plan OT telemetry integration where industrial assets exist.
walk.internalMeaning: Assess OT network visibility and passive collection options.
walk.customerFacingText: Plan OT visibility integration where operational technology is in scope.

walk.label: AI Toolkit baselining
walk.description: Apply ML Toolkit for baseline anomaly detection on key metrics.
walk.internalMeaning: Deploy MLTK baselines on VPN, auth, and network metrics.
walk.customerFacingText: Use machine learning baselines to detect anomalies in key metrics.

walk.label: Index and sourcetype governance
walk.description: Govern indexes, sourcetypes, and naming conventions.
walk.internalMeaning: Document index strategy and sourcetype standards.
walk.customerFacingText: Establish governance for indexes and sourcetypes as scope expands.

walk.label: Cross-region expansion
walk.description: Expand logging to additional regions or business units.
walk.internalMeaning: Onboard regional variants of core sources with consistent parsing.
walk.customerFacingText: Expand consistent logging to additional regions or business units.

walk.label: Vendor TA expansion
walk.description: Deploy additional technical add-ons for new vendor sources.
walk.internalMeaning: Install and configure TAs for walk-phase vendors.
walk.customerFacingText: Deploy technical add-ons needed for expanded vendor coverage.

walk.label: Incident metrics and MTTR
walk.description: Track incident metrics and mean time to respond in Splunk.
walk.internalMeaning: Build MTTR and incident volume dashboards from ticket and alert data.
walk.customerFacingText: Measure incident response metrics to drive improvement.

walk.label: Privacy and access controls
walk.description: Implement role-based access and data privacy controls.
walk.internalMeaning: Configure RBAC, field filtering, and index-level permissions.
walk.customerFacingText: Implement access controls and privacy guardrails as data scope grows.

run.label: Optimize and mature
run.description: Mature detections, automation, and operational processes at scale.
run.internalMeaning: Optimize ingest, detections, and SOC workflows for sustained operations.
run.customerFacingText: Mature the platform with optimized detections, automation, and governance.

run.label: Advanced detection engineering
run.description: Engineer advanced detections with tuning cadence and purple team input.
run.internalMeaning: Maintain detection engineering backlog with ATT&CK mapping.
run.customerFacingText: Advance detection engineering with structured tuning and purple team feedback.

run.label: Risk-based alerting
run.description: Transition to risk-based alerting with asset and threat context.
run.internalMeaning: Deploy RBA with asset criticality and threat context.
run.customerFacingText: Move to risk-based alerting that prioritizes work using business context.

run.label: SOAR readiness
run.description: Prepare full SOAR deployment with playbooks and case management.
run.internalMeaning: Complete SOAR integration with case workflows and playbooks.
run.customerFacingText: Prepare for full security orchestration and automated response.

run.label: Automation playbooks
run.description: Automate top response actions with human-in-the-loop controls.
run.internalMeaning: Deploy production playbooks for enrichment and containment prep.
run.customerFacingText: Automate repeatable response actions with appropriate human oversight.

run.label: ML anomaly candidates
run.description: Operationalize ML-driven anomaly detection on priority domains.
run.internalMeaning: Productionize MLTK or premium ML detections on key metrics.
run.customerFacingText: Operationalize machine learning for anomaly detection at scale.

run.label: Mature SOC workflows
run.description: Run mature SOC tiers, escalation, and on-call integration.
run.internalMeaning: Formalize tier-1/2/3 workflows with on-call and escalation paths.
run.customerFacingText: Operate mature SOC workflows with clear tiers and escalation.

run.label: Executive reporting
run.description: Deliver executive reporting tied to business risk and outcomes.
run.internalMeaning: Produce quarterly executive briefings from Splunk KPIs.
run.customerFacingText: Deliver executive reporting that ties security and ops to business outcomes.

run.label: Performance optimization
run.description: Optimize search, acceleration, and cluster performance.
run.internalMeaning: Tune searches, summaries, and resource utilization.
run.customerFacingText: Optimize platform performance for search speed and cost efficiency.

run.label: Ingest reconciliation
run.description: Reconcile ingest billing, license usage, and source attribution.
run.internalMeaning: Audit ingest per index and reconcile with license entitlements.
run.customerFacingText: Reconcile ingest usage with licensing and source attribution.

run.label: Retention optimization
run.description: Optimize retention tiers and storage costs.
run.internalMeaning: Implement frozen archives and tiered retention policies.
run.customerFacingText: Optimize retention and storage costs while meeting compliance needs.

run.label: Year-two expansion
run.description: Plan and execute year-two scope expansion.
run.internalMeaning: Roadmap additional use cases, sources, and premium apps.
run.customerFacingText: Plan year-two expansion aligned to business priorities.

run.label: Platform governance
run.description: Establish ongoing platform governance and change control.
run.internalMeaning: Run governance council for content, indexes, and apps.
run.customerFacingText: Govern the platform with ongoing change control and standards.

run.label: Continuous improvement
run.description: Maintain continuous improvement cadence for content and operations.
run.internalMeaning: Quarterly content reviews and improvement backlog.
run.customerFacingText: Maintain a continuous improvement program for content and operations.

run.label: Detection tuning cadence
run.description: Run structured detection tuning on a recurring schedule.
run.internalMeaning: Monthly tuning reviews with false-positive tracking.
run.customerFacingText: Run recurring detection tuning to keep alert quality high.

run.label: Threat hunting maturity
run.description: Mature threat hunting with hypothesis backlog and tooling.
run.internalMeaning: Operational hunting program with documented outcomes.
run.customerFacingText: Mature threat hunting with structured hypotheses and outcomes.

run.label: Purple team program
run.description: Integrate purple team exercises with detection content.
run.internalMeaning: Schedule purple team tests mapped to ATT&CK techniques.
run.customerFacingText: Use purple team exercises to validate and improve detections.

run.label: Business KPI integration
run.description: Integrate business KPIs with security and operations metrics.
run.internalMeaning: Correlate security events with business transaction metrics.
run.customerFacingText: Connect security and operations metrics to business KPIs.

run.label: Multi-tenant governance
run.description: Govern multi-team or multi-BU Splunk usage at scale.
run.internalMeaning: Separate indexes, RBAC, and chargeback per tenant.
run.customerFacingText: Govern multi-team Splunk usage with clear boundaries and chargeback.

run.label: Disaster recovery readiness
run.description: Validate DR for Splunk infrastructure and critical content.
run.internalMeaning: Test backup, restore, and DR failover procedures.
run.customerFacingText: Validate disaster recovery for Splunk and critical content.

run.label: Content development standards
run.description: Maintain standards for searches, dashboards, and apps.
run.internalMeaning: Publish and enforce content development standards.
run.customerFacingText: Maintain standards for how teams build and publish Splunk content.

run.label: API and integration hub
run.description: Use Splunk as integration hub for security and IT ecosystems.
run.internalMeaning: Integrate SOAR, ITSM, CMDB, and cloud APIs via Splunk.
run.customerFacingText: Use Splunk as a hub for security and IT ecosystem integrations.

run.label: Observability convergence
run.description: Converge security and observability workflows where appropriate.
run.internalMeaning: Unify APM, logs, and security views for critical services.
run.customerFacingText: Converge observability and security views for critical services.

run.label: Compliance continuous monitoring
run.description: Run continuous compliance monitoring with drift detection.
run.internalMeaning: Automated compliance dashboards with exception workflows.
run.customerFacingText: Monitor compliance continuously with automated drift detection.

run.label: Vendor content adoption
run.description: Adopt and customize vendor content packs at scale.
run.internalMeaning: Curate ES, ITSI, or vendor content with local customization.
run.customerFacingText: Adopt and customize vendor content packs for your environment.

run.label: Cloud-native maturity
run.description: Mature cloud-native logging and container observability.
run.internalMeaning: Full K8s, serverless, and cloud-native monitoring at scale.
run.customerFacingText: Mature cloud-native observability across containers and serverless.

run.label: Security metrics program
run.description: Run a formal security metrics and benchmarking program.
run.internalMeaning: Track security metrics against industry benchmarks.
run.customerFacingText: Run a formal program to measure and benchmark security outcomes.

run.label: Knowledge management
run.description: Maintain knowledge base for searches, runbooks, and lessons learned.
run.internalMeaning: Centralize runbooks and investigation notes in Splunk or ITSM.
run.customerFacingText: Maintain institutional knowledge for searches and investigations.

run.label: Innovation pilot track
run.description: Pilot emerging capabilities (GenAI assist, new apps) safely.
run.internalMeaning: Sandbox pilots for new Splunk capabilities with governance.
run.customerFacingText: Safely pilot emerging capabilities in a governed sandbox.

run.label: Sustainability and cost optimization
run.description: Optimize total cost of ownership for Splunk at scale.
run.internalMeaning: Review license, cloud, and personnel costs quarterly.
run.customerFacingText: Optimize total cost of ownership while maintaining capability.
